queries.name: sensitive_role_permissions
queries.sql: SELECT r.CodigoRol, UPPER(CONCAT(m.CodigoModulo,'_',a.CodigoAccion)) AS PermissionCode, MAX(CASE WHEN ISNULL(r.Activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(prm.Activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(prm.Permitido,0)=1 AND ISNULL(m.Activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(a.Activo,1)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS PermisoActivo FROM dbo.Usuario_Roles AS r INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo AS prm ON prm.RolID=r.RolID INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos AS m ON m.ModuloID=prm.ModuloID INNER JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones AS a ON a.AccionID=prm.AccionID WHERE UPPER(r.CodigoRol) IN ('SUPERADMIN','SUPERADMINISTRADOR','ADMIN','DIRECCION','GERENTE_OPS','SUPERVISOR','OPERADOR') AND UPPER(CONCAT(m.CodigoModulo,'_',a.CodigoAccion)) IN ('CARGOS_CREAR','CARGOS_AUTORIZAR','CARGOS_APLICAR','CARGOS_RECHAZAR','CARGOS_REVERTIR','CARGOS_CANCELAR','RESPONSABILIDAD_CALCULAR','RESPONSABILIDAD_PROPONER','RESPONSABILIDAD_APROBAR','RESPONSABILIDAD_GESTIONAR','NOTIFICACIONES_ENVIAR','NOTIFICACIONES_CONFIGURAR','RBAC_ADMIN') GROUP BY r.CodigoRol, UPPER(CONCAT(m.CodigoModulo,'_',a.CodigoAccion)) ORDER BY r.CodigoRol, PermissionCode

queries.name: role_hierarchy_and_assignments
queries.sql: SELECT r.CodigoRol, r.NivelJerarquia, COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ISNULL(ura.Activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(u.Activo,1)=1 THEN u.UsuarioID ELSE NULL END) AS UsuariosAsignadosActivos FROM dbo.Usuario_Roles AS r LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_RolesAsignacion AS ura ON ura.RolID=r.RolID LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Catalogo AS u ON u.UsuarioID=ura.UsuarioID WHERE UPPER(r.CodigoRol) IN ('SUPERADMIN','SUPERADMINISTRADOR','ADMIN','DIRECCION','GERENTE_OPS','SUPERVISOR','OPERADOR') GROUP BY r.CodigoRol,r.NivelJerarquia ORDER BY r.NivelJerarquia DESC,r.CodigoRol

queries.name: active_user_public_identity_aggregates
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS UsuariosActivos, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN PublicUUID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS SinPublicUUID, COUNT_BIG(DISTINCT PublicUUID) AS PublicUUIDUnicos FROM dbo.Usuario_Catalogo WHERE Activo=1
